selection_basis: Both designs delivered 16/16 accepted models. Baseline won six, adaptive search one, and five tied across 12 validation pairs. Baseline won both repeats on AirPassengers and Houses; adaptive search had no repeated validation win. Retain the simpler baseline; no global-best or convergence claim.
cohort_rationale: Classification fits were unaffected by the Ridge-only correction and independently reassessed. Only corrected-Ridge continuous runs are ranked. All 27 retained bundles were uniformly re-audited at a28f747; five resumed slots used that same verifier. Every original source, record and verifier identity remains explicit.

delivery_denominators.note: Complete comparison: 32 accepted model slots and 34 attempted submissions, 17 per design, including two separately preserved pre-admission preparation failures. One artifact transport incident was recovered from the same run without another training submission.
